project.title: Evidence-Based Value Discovery and Reconnection Pilot
project.purpose: Discover overlooked work value from committed evidence, translate it into externally understandable outputs, and prepare governed connection experiments.
project.current_scope: GitHub and development-log evidence only; human approval is required before publication, outreach, application, or contract.

objective.final_goal: Build an evidence-based path that reconnects overlooked capability to people, organizations, opportunities, and suitable support.
objective.current_goal: Produce the master specification, public evidence structure, and first evidence-backed achievement candidates for CASE-001.
completion_conditions: A contradiction-audited master specification is committed.
At least ten achievement candidates are linked to exact evidence.
At least one human-approved public output asset is prepared without automatic publication.
The run records a deterministic checkpoint and continuation handoff.
The run stops without widening authority.

forbidden_actions: provider use without a new approval gate
target or adjacent-repository write without a new approval gate

work_policy.selection: Choose exactly one highest-priority unfinished deliverable inside current_scope.
work_policy.checkpoint: Persist exact inputs, outputs, evidence, blockers, and next action after every bounded iteration.
work_policy.resume: Resume only from the latest verified checkpoint with unchanged seed and governed fingerprints.
stop_conditions: the same failed action repeats twice without new evidence

known_gaps: real-run effectiveness has not yet been measured
external-market response is not yet observed
no automatic provider or repository adapter is authorized
